scope: Independent compression, lossless codec, numerical and source-code audit of the new whole-scan viewer; parent performs interactive browser checks.
result: Numerical and layout checks pass. Reported exporter and asynchronous selection defects were fixed by the parent and their fixes re-read.
verified: All 4,254 exported native rows exist with their manifested sizes; all 448 previews have complete native spatial dimensions.
3,539,328 native recorded pixels, each with 224 bands, are represented in the row layout.
Actual browser getSpectrum decoded 18,816 tested DN values exactly against independent native BIL reads; all tested quality flags and index availability decisions match.

Normalized Q agrees with existing float32 extraction to maximum absolute difference 1.13e-7. Derived indices differ by at most 1.48e-6 because browser float64 arithmetic and float32 ratio cancellation differ.
Full exact rows plus band JPEG previews occupy 710.036 MiB, before references, RGB context, masks and metadata.
JPEG previews are display-only and never used to recover spectral values. Rotated display coordinates map x to native scan line and y to columns-1-native column.
Reference support, low-signal exclusion for descriptors, white/dark source-line exclusion and missing visible/red indices on FX17 are preserved.
Fixed region selection now reads an actual pixel in that region. Sensor changes clear numerical arrays, disable affected controls and reject stale continuations.
fixed_findings: Reference coverage array already has [224,columns] dimensions; extra axis caused invalid broadcasting.
Initial exporter claimed global completion after the first camera; source now sets completion only after both cameras finish.
Region dropdown previously relabelled an unchanged selected pixel with another region.
Camera switching previously left earlier sensor numerical arrays available under new metadata while loading.
limits: This does not establish calibrated reflectance, plant physiological health, same-tissue RGB correspondence or new physical 3D fusion.
Raw DN is bit-exact; normalized floating-point values are numerically equivalent within the stated tolerance, not bit-identical to float32 historical arrays.
The source-code async review complements the parent's browser interaction checks; it is not a substitute for those checks.
The completed export receipt was written before the new export_complete field was introduced, but independently contains both sensors and a final completion timestamp.
